title: ASSISTANT CREWING MANAGER
description:
Immediate Hiring!
Bismark Maritime Limited is looking for a qualified young individual to fill in below position.
Position: ASSISTANT CREWING MANAGER
Location: Port Moresby
Job Brief:
The role will provide management support to the Crewing Manager for day-to-day activities of Crewing Department with the objective of ensuring the vessels are fully manned with qualified seafarers.
Qualification and Requirements:
Bachelors Degree of any Business related or Human Resource courses.
With proven experience in Crewing or worked previously on the same role.
Capable of managing daily crewing operations including but not limited to recruitment, documentations, compliance and administrative duties.
Excellent knowledge in Crew statutory NMSA requirements and MLC 2006 standards including PNG Worker compliance both local and expatriates.
With high confidence in dealing with executive management.
Ability to handle and with high tolerance in dealing different types of personalities.
Organized and keen to details.
Self-motivated and excellent work ethic.
Can work on-call and beyond normal working hours.
Flexible in a fast paced working environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office software.
Must have good English communication skills – verbal and written.
Must be residing in Port Moresby.
Interested applicants meeting the above qualifications and have the requirements, you may submit your updated CV with photo and credentials thru either of the following:
Via Email to:
[email protected]
Via Hand deliver to: Bismark Maritime Limited Office in Port Moresby (Sec. 37, Lot 1-2, Konedobu Road). See our Reception Counter.
